title: Pinned normal frames and centred Rees charts
statement: For a separated morphism h:U→V, rank d and ordered global functions x_i, define NormalFrame and CentredChart by the following precise fields: the canonical symmetric comparison, positive difference conormal identification, free differential frame, normal cone frame over U preserving zero and degree-one coordinates, normalized comparison independence and rank-zero identifications; the centred open zero square and etale Rees morphism with its restriction model, both endpoints and every affine Laurent formula. Define CentredChart.map as its model isomorphism followed by its deformation map. These are the existing structures and composite without any change of fields or bodies.
